25	def rel_entr(pk: np.ndarray, qk: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
26	    """
27	    See https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.special.rel_entr.html#scipy.special.rel_entr.
28	    Python implementation.
29	    """
30	    res = np.empty(pk.shape, dtype=pk.dtype)
31	    res[:] = pk[:] * np.log(pk[:] / qk[:])
32	    c2 = (pk == 0) & (qk >= 0)
33	    res[c2] = 0
34	    c1 = (pk > 0) & (qk > 0)
35	    res[~c1] = np.inf
36	    return res

43	    axis: int = 0,

45	    """

47	    Source: https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.entropy.html.
48	    This avoids taking a dependency on scipy just for this function.
49	    """

51	    assert qk is not None, "qk is None"

53	    pk = np.asarray(pk).astype(np.float32)
